about:
I'm Aarush. I'm 15, and coding is genuinely one of my favorite things to do — not just as a school subject, but as something I build real stuff with in my own time.

I got into building actual websites when I started using AI tools to handle the boring, repetitive parts of coding. That freed up time to focus on what I actually care about: making something look good and work right, not just exist.

This is a real, small side business. I build websites for local businesses that need one but don't want to pay agency prices for it. I handle the design, the code, and I set it up so you can update prices, photos, or listings yourself — no calling me every time something small needs to change.
